spoken_script: Google just broke the output limit of artificial intelligence. Google officially launched Gemini 4 Argon, featuring an unprecedented one-million-token output limit. Deployed in the Fairwind Program, it autonomously discovers and patches zero-day vulnerabilities in critical infrastructure. The bottleneck on long-horizon reasoning has vanished.
